title: Especialista em IA Generativa
description:
Especialista em IA Generativa (LLMs)

Modelo: 100% Remoto

Modelo de Contratação: CLT


Venha construir o futuro da IA com um dos líderes em tecnologia do Brasil!

Junte-se ao Escritório de Projetos em Inteligência Artificial e lidere iniciativas com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), frameworks de agentes como CrewAI e Llama-Index, e soluções de ponta em RAG.


Descrição do Cargo:

1) Desenvolver e avaliar soluções baseadas em LLMs, incluindo pipelines com RAG e frameworks como CrewAI e Llama-Index.

2) Medir o desempenho de modelos e agentes com métricas, testes A/B e abordagens como LLM-as-a-judge.

3) Contribuir na arquitetura técnica e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo boas práticas em engenharia de IA.


Requisitos:

1) Formação superior completa (desejável mestrado na área) e sólida experiência com LLMs e técnicas de RAG.

2) Conhecimento prático em frameworks de agentes como CrewAI, Llama-Index ou similares.

3) Vivência na avaliação de LLMs (quantitativa e qualitativa), incluindo uso de LLMs as a judge

3) Experiência com Docker, pipelines de ETL, ambientes produtivos e liderança técnica.

4) Inglês Intermediário



Diferenciais: atuação com IA Generativa Multimodal, desenvolvimento de chatbots inteligentes, serviços AWS e participação em workshops/discovery de IA.

title: Business Analyst - Clinical trials or life sciences domain
description:
Business Analyst - Clinical trials or life sciences domain

Remote-Brazil

Contract

Key Responsibilities:

Understand and document business and data requirements across clinical domains and translate them into actionable technical tasks

Manage and maintain Jira boards for the Data Engineering team: groom stories, track progress, and coordinate with developers, QA, and stakeholders

Act as a liaison between product, engineering, and external stakeholders to clarify requirements and ensure alignment across teams

Drive the creation and maintenance of data entity mapping documentation between legacy systems and Medidata CTMS

Collaborate with engineering leads to support ETL and data pipeline validation, including defining edge cases and expected behaviors

Support UAT efforts for data integration/migration projects by coordinating validation cycles with clinical users and data stakeholders

Identify risks, gaps, or inconsistencies in incoming data requirements and proactively resolve them

Participate in data migration planning and execution experience with previous system-to-system migrations is a strong plus


Required Qualifications:

Minimum of 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical BA in the clinical trials or life sciences domain

Strong understanding of clinical data and clinical workflows

Experience with Jira, Confluence, and Agile/Scrum delivery models

Familiarity with data models, data structures, and relational data concepts (SQL knowledge is a plus)

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics for non-technical stakeholders

Ability to manage multiple workstreams and keep deliverables on track

Proven ability to create clear, structured documentation (e.g., data dictionaries, mappings, process flows)


Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with clinical data migrations (e.g from Veeva, Oracle, or other CTMS systems to other systems)

Understanding of ETL pipelines or working experience with data engineering teams

Knowledge of CTMS, eTMF, EDC/Rave, or other clinical trial technologies

About Ampstek

Ampstek is a global IT solutions partner serving clients across North America, Europe, APAC, LATAM, and MEA. We specialize in delivering talent and technology solutions for enterprise-level digital transformation, trading systems, data services, and regulatory compliance.

Contact:

title: Contracting Manager
description:
Contracting Manager

Location – Brazil

Full Time


About Us

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard-to-reach high-value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course, we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality.


Job Summary:

As the face of Hotelbeds to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of hotels within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for Hotelbeds.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of Hotelbeds value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or hospitality industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

Job Summary:

As the face of Hotelbeds to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of hotels within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for Hotelbeds.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of Hotelbeds value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or hospitality industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Security Manager
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Especialista Data Science
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Você fará parte do time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais.

O time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais atua de forma transversal na companhia em projetos de alto potencial de impacto financeiro explorando métodos estatísticos e de aprendizagem de máquina. Estamos em busca de um profissional especialista em Ciência de Dados com experiência comprovada para impulsionar nosso crescimento e inovação através da utilização eficiente e impactante dos dados.


Seu papel:

Seu dia a dia será assim:

  • Construir produtos de dados centrados no usuário (pipelines, indicadores, dashboards);
  • Desenvolver datasets que representem a "fonte da verdade" (Gold/Diamond - arquitetura medalhão);
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas plataformas;
  • Automatizar e escalar processos internos com b ase em dados;
  • Promover o uso estratégico dos dados na resolução de problemas de negócio;
  • Manter e evoluir pipelines de análise com abordagem de dados como produto;
  • Monitorar performance da infraestrutura analítica (data quality);
  • Criar análises, gráficos e dashboards a partir da estrutura de dados construída;
  • Colaborar com engenheiros em projetos de infraestrutura de dados;
  • Monitorar a qualidade dos dados: Assegurar a precisão e consistência dos dados utilizados nas análises;
  • Suportar a implantação e utilizar o catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos de dados, garantindo que as políticas de governança sejam seguidas.



O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter formação em cursos que abranjam esses conhecimentos: Ciência da computação, Data Science, Data analytics;
  • Proficiência em SQL: Habilidade para escrever e otimizar consultas complexas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de dados, como Metabase, Power BI, etc.;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação para análise de dados: Python, R ou outras semelhantes.;
  • Habilidades analíticas e estatísticas: Capacidade de aplicar técnicas estatísticas para resolver problemas de negócios;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação: Habilidade para explicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara e concisa a públicos não técnicos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de ETL: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Azure Data Factory ou similares;
  • Orientação para resultados: Foco em alcançar metas e melhorar os processos de negócios com base em dados.



Ferramentas e Tecnologias:

  • SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Python e suas bibliotecas relevantes (Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch ).
  • Databricks e/ou Spark para processamento e engenharia de dados em larga escala.


O que pode te destacar:

  • Experiência com Governança de Dados e monitoramento de modelos de Machine Learning em produção.
  • Atuação prática com LLMs aplicados a problemas de negócio .
  • Conhecimento de MLOps e boas práticas de versionamento e implantação de modelos.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Project Manager
description:
Cargo: Project Manager - PM´s

Local e Formato de Trabalho: 100% Remoto. (Brasil)

Modelo de contrato: PJ subcontratado pela Net2Source



Para liderar de forma eficaz um projeto no Brasil com foco na Reforma Tributária Brasileira e atualização do Oracle EBS , o Gerente de Projetos deve possuir as seguintes habilidades e competências:

  • Bilíngue (português e inglês );
  • Proficiência em planejamento de projetos , agendamento, alocação de recursos, gestão de riscos e de tarefas;
  • Compreensão das regulamentações fiscais brasileiras e dos requisitos de conformidade . Conhecimento sobre impactos da Reforma Tributária será considerado um diferencial;
  • Capacidade de coordenar uma equipe multidisciplinar (negócios, infraestrutura, tecnologia e equipes funcionais);
  • Familiaridade com a arquitetura, os módulos e os processos de atualização do Oracle E-Business Suite será considerado um diferencial;
  • Experiência na gestão de projetos de atualização de ERP , incluindo testes, customização e integração, será considerado um diferencial;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma eficaz com equipes locais, partes interessadas e fornecedores;
  • Habilidade para engajar e gerenciar diversos stakeholders, incluindo usuários de negócios, equipes de TI, fornecedores externos e órgãos reguladores;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação para fornecer atualizações claras, gerenciar expectativas e resolver conflitos;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas para identificar problemas, avaliar riscos e tomar decisões embasadas.



Qualificações Desejadas:

• Graduação completa ou superior em Gestão de Sistemas de Informação , Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas;

• Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em Gerenciamento de Projetos de TI ou disciplinas relacionadas – Certificação PMP ou PgMP é desejável;

• Fortes habilidades analíticas e conceituais;

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, incluindo redação técnica;

• Forte orientação a sistemas e processos;

• Deve sentir-se confortável trabalhando remotamente e com pouca interação presencial com colegas e gestores;

• Experiência comprovada em entrega bem-sucedida de projetos/programas de TI;

• Capacidade de influenciar profissionais de negócios quanto aos motivos para adoção de soluções recomendadas, por meio de conhecimento funcional e visão de negócio;

• Capacidade de trabalhar sem supervisão próxima;

• Perfil proativo, comprometido com a entrega de trabalhos de alta qualidade em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado;

• Capacidade comprovada de fomentar o desenvolvimento de membros juniores da equipe.

title: Profissional Back End – .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 55483


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET em suas versões antigas e atuais.
  • Experiência com AWS e suas principais ferramentas.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria como RabbitMQ.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e NoSQL como MongoDB e outros.
  • Experiência em processos de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


- Diferenciais:

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Executivo de contas
description:
Missão da vaga

Fechar contratos de alto valor com grandes construtoras e incorporadoras , usando abordagem consultiva , demonstrações técnicas e relacionamento estratégico.


Responsabilidades (diretas e objetivas)

  • Prospecção ativa e qualificada com diretores, gerentes de engenharia e gestores de incorporação.
  • Realizar apresentações e demonstrações da experiência Twinny VR.
  • Diagnosticar necessidades e construir propostas técnicas e comerciais.
  • Gerenciar pipeline no CRM, do primeiro contato ao fechamento.
  • Negociar contratos entre R$ 100 mil e R$ 500 mil .
  • Trabalhar diretamente com o diretor comercial.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B complexas (mínimo 2 anos).
  • Histórico de vendas para construtoras, incorporadoras ou empresas técnicas.
  • Domínio de vendas consultivas (solution selling / challenger selling).
  • Capacidade de explicar produtos tecnológicos para cargos de diretoria.
  • Know-how em demonstrar soluções digitais (SaaS, VR, BIM ou similares).
  • Perfil hunter + closer (prospecta e fecha).


Diferenciais fortes

  • Vendeu softwares de engenharia, BIM, VR, AR, digital twin ou tecnologia para construção.
  • Experiência com integração entre comercial e produto.
  • Histórico de contratos acima de R$ 200 mil.
  • Relacionamento prévio com construtoras.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

  • Produto diferenciado e de alto impacto comercial.
  • Total autonomia comercial.
  • Processo acelerado: o comercial conversa direto com diretoria.
  • Oportunidade de crescer junto com uma empresa em expansão real.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net com IA
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações .NET (C#) com arquitetura MVC e princípios de DDD (Domain-Driven Design) .
  • Implementar e consumir APIs REST , garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Criar e otimizar consultas e procedures em SQL Server .
  • Realizar testes unitários para assegurar a qualidade e estabilidade das entregas.
  • Utilizar Dapper para mapeamento objeto-relacional e acesso eficiente a dados.
  • Trabalhar com microserviços e containers utilizando Docker e Azure Cloud (ou AWS quando aplicável).
  • Colaborar em pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps , automatizando build, testes e deploy.
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias Ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban) , contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do time e dos processos.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento, code review e documentação técnica.
  • Explorar e aplicar ferramentas de produtividade e inteligência como Cursor AI e Vibe Coding no desenvolvimento diário.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em .NET Framework e .NET MVC (C#).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio ao desenvolvimento como Visual Studio Code , Cursor AI e Vibe Coding .
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software com foco em DDD e microserviços .
  • Vivência com Dapper e SQL Server (queries, procedures, tuning de performance).
  • Domínio de APIs RESTful , testes unitários e boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.
  • Experiência em integração e entrega contínua com Azure DevOps .
  • Familiaridade com Azure Cloud e Docker para deploy e orquestração de aplicações.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) .
  • Desejável experiência com AWS , CI/CD pipelines e práticas DevOps.



Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Purchasing / Sourcing Specialist (Remote / USD)
description:
Purchasing / Sourcing Specialist (Full-Time / USD)


Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $1,800–$2,300/month (depending on experience and scope)

Working Hours: 6 AM – 2 PM EST or at least 6 hours overlap within this window


About the Role

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and cost-conscious Purchasing / Sourcing Specialist to manage and optimize supplier relationships for our Amazon private-label and marketplace operations.

You’ll lead sourcing and negotiations with manufacturers, build landed cost models, and oversee end-to-end execution across samples, purchase orders, and logistics. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with operational rigor — ensuring smooth, margin-focused supply chain performance from factory to FBA/3PL.


Key Responsibilities

  • Source, vet, and onboard manufacturers; run RFQs and negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms.
  • Build and maintain accurate landed cost models, factoring in duties, freight, and FBA fees to achieve margin targets.
  • Coordinate product samples, specifications, labeling, packaging, and compliance with Amazon and category standards.
  • Create and track POs from production through delivery; ensure on-time, in-full (OTIF) supplier and carrier performance.
  • Monitor vendor performance (cost, quality, lead time, defect rate) and lead corrective actions as needed.
  • Conduct supplier audits and risk assessments (geopolitical, compliance, capacity).
  • Identify and execute cost-saving initiatives through negotiation, packaging optimization, or alternate sourcing.
  • Drive continuous improvement in sourcing processes and supplier performance.


✅ Requirements

  • 3+ years in purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain management, ideally within Amazon FBA or e-commerce.
  • Proven experience negotiating with overseas factories (pricing, MOQs, payment terms).
  • Strong understanding of landed cost analysis, margins, and Amazon’s fee structures.
  • Knowledge of quality control checkpoints and product compliance.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with PO or ERP systems preferred.
  • Highly organized, with strong documentation and multi-SKU project management ability.
  • Proactive, analytical, and comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Helium 10, Keepa, or other sourcing/market analysis tools.
  • Experience with EDI, inventory planning, or demand forecasting.
  • Exposure to regulated product categories or Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.

title: SDR - Sales Development Representative
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma escola 100% online especializada em infoprodutos sobre Inteligência Artificial para Advogados. Trabalhamos com um modelo remoto e buscamos pessoas altamente comprometidas em entregar resultados!


Modalidade:

100% Remoto

Necessário possuir: Computador / Notebook e headset


Responsabilidades

Como SDR, você será a primeira linha de contato com nossos leads e terá um papel fundamental em identificar, engajar e qualificar potenciais clientes para o time de closers.


Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Entrar em contato com leads através de WhatsApp, e-mail e ligações;
  • Realizar qualificação inicial dos leads, aplicando o método SPIN Selling;
  • Alimentar o CRM com informações detalhadas sobre os leads (situação atual, desafios e potencial de conversão);
  • Agendar reuniões para os closers com leads qualificados (SQLs);
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com marketing e closers para otimizar cadências e melhorar taxas de conversão.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior como SDR ou em atendimento ao cliente com foco comercial é um diferencial;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM;
  • Conhecimento de métodos de qualificação de leads (como BANT ou SPIN Selling) é um diferencial;
  • Interesse pelo mercado jurídico e por tecnologia (IA).


O que Oferecemos:

  • Bônus por desempenho: Incentivos financeiros proporcionais aos resultados alcançados;
  • Treinamentos regulares: Desenvolvimento contínuo em técnicas de vendas e qualificação;
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo: Equipe focada em alta performance e aprendizado constante;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em um mercado inovador e em expansão.


Modelo de Remuneração:

  • Base fixa inicial em R$1518,00
  • +R$10 por agendamento realizado
  • +0.5% dos agendamentos fechados
  • Bônus por metas atingidas


  • Meta para o SDR nos Primeiros 3 Meses: processar 500 a 750 leads/mês (inbound e outbound combinados);
  • Qualificar 100 SQLs/mês


Se você é resiliente, organizado e busca uma oportunidade de crescer em vendas enquanto impacta a transformação do mercado jurídico, esperamos sua candidatura!

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.


Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. Zensar is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Zensar is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. Zensar is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for persons with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. Accommodations made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodations once hired.


Zensar does not facilitate/sponsor any work authorization for this position. All candidates must present valid authorization to commence new employment in the country for Zensar.

Candidates who are currently employed by a client or vendor of Zensar may be ineligible for consideration.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Product Manager
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Senior experience: 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a senior product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Req English)
description:
3thix
Remote-First (Global) | Full-Time
About 3thix
3thix is a next-generation fintech platform bridging traditional payments with blockchain rails. We power seamless, low-cost, and compliant transfers using stable tokens, smart contracts, and hybrid on/off-ramp infrastructure. Backed by top-tier VCs, we process millions in daily volume and are expanding into new corridors and asset classes.
The Role
We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in fintech payment systems, blockchain protocols, and stable token ecosystems (USDC, USDT, EURC, etc.). You’ll design, build, and scale the core transaction engine that routes fiat ↔ crypto, settles on-chain, and ensures regulatory compliance at every step.
What You’ll Do
Architect and maintain high-throughput payment orchestration services handling fiat deposits, crypto swaps, stable token mint/burn, and instant settlements.
Build reconciliation systems that sync on-chain events (EVM, Solana, Stellar) with off-chain ledgers and banking rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT, SPEI).
Implement risk, fraud, and AML controls in real-time transaction pipelines.
Design idempotent, event-driven microservices using Kafka / Pulsar and domain-driven patterns.
Own blockchain node infrastructure (Geth, Solana RPC, custom indexers) and write secure smart-contract interaction layers.
Scale systems to 10k+ TPS with sub-100ms latency for cross-border flows.
Collaborate with compliance and product teams to embed KYC/KYT, travel-rule data, and sanction screening.
Lead incident response for payment disputes, rollbacks, and chain re-orgs.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years backend engineering in high-scale environments.
Production experience in fintech / payments (acquiring, issuing, remittance, or payout systems).
Deep blockchain knowledge:
EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum)
Stable token standards (ERC-20, SPL, CCTP)
MEV, gas optimization, and on-chain data indexing (The Graph, Dune, custom subsql)
Mastery of Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node.js (we primarily use Go).
Event sourcing, CQRS, and distributed transaction patterns.
Secure handling of HSMs, key management (KMS, MPC), and cryptographic signing.
Observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK.
Experience with regulated environments (PCI-DSS, SOC2, PSD2, FinCEN travel rule).
Nice-to-Have
Built or audited stablecoin issuance/redemption systems.
Contributed to open-source blockchain tooling or payment protocols.
Worked with layer-2 networks (Optimism, Base, zkSync) or cross-chain bridges.
Familiarity with ISO 20022, FedNow, or RTP rails.
Tech Stack
Core: Go, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
Blockchain: Solidity, Hardhat, Foundry, ethers.js, viem, Solana SDK
Infra: Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP/AWS, Grafana Tempo
Security: HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Fireblocks MPC
Why Join 3thix
Equity in a rocket-ship startup.
Unlimited PTO + global off-sites.
Top-tier health, dental, and remote workspace stipend.
Work directly with ex-Stripe, Circle, and Coinbase engineers.
Shape the future of programmable money.

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

title: Gerente de ERP e Transformação Digital
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de ERP e Transformação Digital para uma empresa localizada em São Paulo/SP.


Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!


Objetivo da posição:

Será responsável por liderar a transformação digital do Grupo, com foco na migração e implantação de um novo ERP e na integração das unidades no Brasil, México, Colômbia e futuras operações internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o plano diretor de tecnologia e alinhar TI à estratégia “Grupo 2030”;
  • Conduzir o processo de seleção e implantação do ERP, do diagnóstico ao pós-go-live;
  • Promover governança tecnológica, segurança da informação e compliance digital;
  • Estruturar padrões e sistemas unificados para operações internacionais;
  • Gerir infraestrutura, contratos e equipe interna/externa de TI;
  • Atuar como agente estratégico de transformação digital com visão de eficiência e crescimento.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em posições de liderança em TI, com histórico comprovado de implantação de ERP de grande porte (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS Protheus/RM, etc.).
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração de infraestrutura tecnológica, seja em transição para nuvem, ambientes híbridos ou reestruturações locais.
  • Vivência no setor industrial, preferencialmente em grupos com unidades produtivas e atuação internacional.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de soluções para manufatura, supply chain e engenharia (ex: integração de ERP com PLM, WMS, CRM, BI, manutenção, etc.) será considerado um diferencial relevante.
  • Espanhol desejável


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!


O que buscamos:

A Worldpanel está em busca de um(a) Analista de Pesquisa de Mercado Sênior com interesse genuíno em entender o comportamento do consumidor e transformar dados em insights que orientem decisões estratégicas. Se você tem espírito investigativo, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de trabalhar com dados e pessoas, essa vaga pode ser para você!


As responsabilidades incluem:

  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, especialmente o time comercial;
  • Receber, analisar e criticar briefings, produzindo materiais alinhados às demandas;
  • Atuar em atividades de maior complexidade e interagir com stakeholders seniores;
  • Participar, quando possível, das apresentações para clientes;
  • Diagnosticar oportunidades de negócio nos clientes para abordagem comercial;
  • Produzir insights adicionais que possam gerar novas oportunidades;
  • Participar de reuniões de briefing com clientes, se necessário;
  • Sintetizar informações, construir storytelling com dados e comunicar-se bem com diferentes públicos;
  • Cumprir os prazos estabelecidos no cronograma de entregas (SLA e priorizações).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em análise de mercado, comportamento do consumidor ou inteligência de mercado;
  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Comunicação, Estatística, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pensamento analítico, visão estratégica, autonomia, organização e proatividade;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em pacote Office;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e habilidades para resolver problemas;
  • Inglês avançado (desejável espanhol intermediário);
  • Conhecimento na plataforma Jira será considerado diferencial.


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Horário Flexível;
  • Home-office;
  • Programa Qualidade de Vida: Totalpass, participação em corridas, vacinação contra gripe, palestras sobre temas relevantes e muito mais;
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna – a Worldpanel valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


﻿Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead the design, development, and maintenance of their web applications. You will play a key role in shaping the architecture of the frontend, mentoring team members, and driving technical excellence. Their stack includes React, AWS Amplify, and serverless backends with Lambda and PostgreSQL.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will write code, guide others, enforce best practices, and ensure scalable, maintainable, and high-performance frontends.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead frontend architecture decisions and define patterns for React applications.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize complex web applications.
  • Mentor and guide junior/mid-level engineers, providing code reviews and feedback.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to deliver high-quality features.
  • Implement robust client-side integrations with APIs (REST/GraphQL), AWS Amplify, and Cognito.
  • Develop reusable, scalable, and modular component libraries.
  • Ensure high performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices and browsers.
  • Establish and enforce frontend best practices, coding standards, and testing strategies.
  • Participate in deployment planning, release management, and post-release monitoring.
  • Drive improvements in observability, error tracking, and user analytics.
  • Identify technical debt and lead initiatives to reduce it.
  • Lead design discussions for UX/UI consistency, performance optimizations, and frontend security.


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in frontend development with React.
  • Expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend frameworks.
  • Experience with AWS Amplify, Cognito, and serverless architecture (Lambda, API Gateway).
  • Strong understanding of client-server interactions and integrating with backend APIs.
  • Proven experience in leading projects or mentoring engineers.
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library) and test-driven development.
  • Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and optimization skills.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and agile development practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with complex state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, or similar).
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL or backend workflows for frontend integration.
  • Experience designing or maintaining design systems or UI component libraries.
  • Knowledge of web performance profiling, accessibility standards, and security best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with analytics and instrumentation (Segment, GA, Sentry, DataDog).
  • Experience in serverless observability tools (X-Ray, CloudWatch, etc.).


Success Indicators:

  • Delivers scalable, performant, and maintainable frontend applications.
  • Mentors and uplifts the skills of other engineers.
  • Leads architecture decisions that improve developer productivity and system reliability.
  • Proactively identifies and mitigates performance, accessibility, or UX issues.
  • Consistently collaborates with cross-functional teams to meet business goals.


Tools You May Use:

  • React, TypeScript, JavaScript
  • AWS Amplify, Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito
  • PostgreSQL (RDS)
  • Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress
  • GitHub / GitLab, CI/CD pipelines
  • Design tools: Figma, Zeplin, or Sketch
  • Monitoring/Observability: Sentry, DataDog, CloudWatch, X-Ray
  • AI Prompting: Cursor, ChatGPT


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a forward-thinking company transforming the future of film and television production through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Work Schedule:  Pacific Standard Time


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.
